description: This file defines the {@code ResizableDoubleArray} class within the Apache Commons Math3 library. It implements a dynamic, expandable array structure for storing double values that can grow and contract as elements are added or removed. It includes functionality for adding elements, rolling additions, expanding, contracting, and managing internal storage efficiently with customizable expansion modes and criteria.

classes.name: ResizableDoubleArray
classes.description: A variable length array that handles expansion and contraction automatically; implements the DoubleArray interface, Serializable, and supports thread-safe operations (though usage is discouraged for multi-threaded contexts). Provides methods for adding, setting, removing, and copying elements, with configurable expansion modes and contraction criteria.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a double value to the end of the array, expanding internal storage if necessary.

methods.name: addElements
methods.description: Adds multiple values to the end of the array, extending internal storage accordingly.

methods.name: addElementRolling
methods.description: Adds an element to the end and removes the front element, returning the discarded value, effectively functioning as a rolling queue.

methods.name: substituteMostRecentElement
methods.description: Replaces the most recently added element with a new value, returning the old value.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the array, removing all elements.

methods.name: contract
methods.description: Reduces internal storage array to fit the number of stored elements.

methods.name: discardFrontElements
methods.description: Removes a specified number of elements from the front.

methods.name: discardMostRecentElements
methods.description: Removes a specified number of elements from the end.

methods.name: setNumElements
methods.description: Sets the number of active elements, expanding storage if necessary.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Retrieves the element at a specific index.

methods.name: getElements
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current elements as an array.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands internal storage based on expansion mode and factor.
